title: KappaForge requirement classification
description: The classifier's answer: one entry per requirement id, with one or more categories. Classification never grants execution, write, merge, release or deployment permission; any field not listed here is ignored.

categoryMeanings.housekeeping: The pull request, branch or repository bookkeeping
categoryMeanings.research: Looking up documentation, versions or APIs
categoryMeanings.owner_decision: Something only the owner may decide or authorize, such as merging, deploying, releasing or changing access
